name: Treasury #1 rule, version 2
plain: Keep 10% in dollars, or 3 months of bills.
Keep bills under what the dividends pay.
The rest: 8 parts digital credit (STRC, SATA), 1 part bitcoin.
No company over half of the digital credit.
Dividends buy bitcoin dips (10% under its 30-day high).
Never sell. A move over 5% of the treasury waits for a human yes.
